stem.text: Which alcohol can be dehydrated to give two products which are structural isomers of each other?

A.alt: Displayed formula of CH3CH2CH2CH2OH (butan-1-ol): a four-carbon straight chain with OH on the end carbon

B.alt: Displayed formula of CH3CH2CH(OH)CH3 (butan-2-ol): OH and a methyl branch on the third carbon of the chain

C.alt: Displayed formula of CH3CH(CH3)CH2OH (2-methylpropan-1-ol): a methyl branch on the middle carbon, OH on the end carbon

D.alt: Displayed formula of CH3C(CH3)2OH (2-methylpropan-2-ol): OH and two methyl groups on the central carbon
